symptom.detail: ChiefEngineerBlueprintErrorV1: task behavior bindings reference unknown invariants

dynamic_evidence.first_missing_detection_boundary: factory_ce_evidence.chief_engineer_portfolio_output_errors returned no cross-field error, so the final schema-valid candidate skipped the existing typed semantic-repair branch and failed later in the authoritative portfolio builder.

root_cause: The CE pre-projection output validator checked the type of task behavior_invariant_refs and validated each declared invariant, but never checked that every task ref resolved to a shared_behavior_contract invariant_id. This coverage gap stranded a repairable schema-valid candidate after the three schema-reconstruction calls.

fix.behavior: Before authoritative portfolio construction, reject task behavior refs that do not resolve to declared invariant ids. The stable error text includes shared_behavior_contract so the existing diagnosis maps it to chief_engineer.shared_behavior_contract.invalid and authorizes typed behavior_invariant_upsert/task_behavior_ref_replace repair in the same run and role.

verification.red: The exact-pattern unit test returned [] instead of the unknown-invariant error.
verification.fresh_e2e: r84 failed earlier during CE schema repair on one physical HTTP 529 response; the r83 cross-field semantic path was not reached

guardrails.repair_scope: same CE run and frozen candidate only
